biography.value:
Description

This small black whimsical-looking creature darts about swiftly on purple colored gossamer wings.

Defense

AC 22, touch 19, flat-footed 14 (+7 dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural, +1 size)

hp 45 [70] (10d6+10)

mp 39

Fort +4, Ref +14, Will +10

Defensive Abilities Charmed Life, Invisibility;

DR 10/cold iron;

Resist Shadow 15;

SR 17;

Weakness Holy

Offense

Speed 20 ft., Fly 60 ft. (perfect)

Melee Longsword +13 (1d6-1/19-20)

Range Longbow +13 (1d6-1/x3)

Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Special Abilities Winter Breeze

Special Attacks Black Wind, Lethe Arrow, Zephyr Arrow

Spells Known (Black Mage/Illusionist CL 10th, Concentration +14)

At will (DC 14) - Dancing Lights, Dark Orb, Daze, Ghost Sound

1st (DC 15) - Color Spray, Dark, Enfeeblement, Mage Armor, Silent Image

2nd (DC 16) - Blur, Dark II, Darkness, Jitterbugs, Magic Mouth

Statistics

Str 8, Dex 24, Con 13, Int 18, Wis 16, Cha 18

Base Atk +5; CMB +3; CMD 10

Feats Combat Casting, Dark Focus, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse

Skills Acrobatics +16, Bluff +14, Escape Artist +16, Fly +22, Knowledge (nature) +15, Perception +13, Sense Motive +14, Stealth +20, Use Magic Device +14

Languages Common, Sylvan

Gear Longsword, longbow, quiver (10 arrows)
